description: This PHP source file defines the ApplicantController class within the OrangeHRM recruitment module. It handles candidate application submissions, including processing uploaded resumes, validating input parameters, creating candidate records, associating candidates with vacancies, and saving attachments. The controller implements the handle method to process incoming HTTP requests, manage transactions, and redirect users upon success or failure.

classes.name: ApplicantController
classes.description: Controller class responsible for handling candidate application submissions, including validation, processing uploaded files, creating candidate and vacancy records, attaching resumes, and managing database transactions.

methods.name: handle
methods.description: Main entry point to handle HTTP POST requests for applicant submissions. Validates uploaded resume, parameters, manages transaction flow, and redirects accordingly.

methods.name: validateParameters
methods.description: Validates request parameters and the uploaded resume attachment to ensure they meet predefined rules and that the vacancy is active and published.

methods.name: processTransaction
methods.description: Handles the creation of candidate record, vacancy association, candidate history, and attachment saving within a database transaction.

methods.name: setApplicant
methods.description: Populates a Candidate entity with data from the HTTP request.

methods.name: setApplicantVacancy
methods.description: Associates a CandidateVacancy entity with candidate and vacancy IDs, sets status and application date.

methods.name: getValidationDecorator
methods.description: Lazily instantiates and returns the ValidationDecorator used for parameter validation.

methods.name: getParamRuleCollection
methods.description: Defines and returns the set of validation rules for the request parameters.

methods.name: setCandidateAttachment
methods.description: Associates a CandidateAttachment entity with candidate ID and resume content details.
